name: TablesOfFigures
description: A collection of TableOfFigures objects that represent the tables of figures in a document.
remarks: Use the TablesOfFigures property to return the TablesOfFigures collection. The following example applies the Classic format to all tables of figures in the active document. Use the Add method to add a table of figures to a document. A table of figures lists figure captions in the order in which they appear in the document. The following example replaces the selection in the active document with a table of figures that includes caption labels and page numbers. Use TablesOfFigures (Index), where Index is the index number, to return a single TableOfFigures object. The index number represents the position of the table of figures in the document. The following example updates the page numbers of the items in the first table of figures in the active document.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified TablesOfFigures object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of tables of figures in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Format
properties.description: Returns or sets the formatting for the tables of figures in the specified document. Read/write WdTofFormat.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual TableOfFigures object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned. Can be a Long indicating the ordinal position of the individual object.

methods.name: MarkEntry
methods.signature: MarkEntry(Range As Range, [Entry As Variant], [EntryAutoText As Variant], [TableID As Variant], [Level As Variant]) As Field
methods.description: Inserts a TC (Table of Contents Entry) field after the specified range. The method returns a Field object representing the TC field.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The location of the entry. The TC field is inserted after Range.

parameters.name: Entry
parameters.description: The text that appears in the table of contents or table of figures. To indicate a subentry, include the main entry text and the subentry text, separated by a colon (:) (for example, "Introduction:The Product").

parameters.name: EntryAutoText
parameters.description: The AutoText entry name that includes text for the index, table of figures, or table of contents (Entry is ignored).

parameters.name: TableID
parameters.description: A one-letter identifier for the table of figures or table of contents item (for example, "i" for an "illustration").

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description: A level for the entry in the table of contents or table of figures.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Range As Range, [Caption As Variant], [IncludeLabel As Variant], [UseHeadingStyles As Variant], [UpperHeadingLevel As Variant], [LowerHeadingLevel As Variant], [UseFields As Variant], [TableID As Variant], [RightAlignPageNumbers As Variant], [IncludePageNumbers As Variant], [AddedStyles As Variant], [UseHyperlinks As Variant], [HidePageNumbersInWeb As Variant]) As TableOfFigures
methods.description: Returns a TableOfFigures object that represents a table of figures added to a document.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The range where you want the table of figures to appear.

parameters.name: Caption
parameters.description: The label that identifies the items you want to include in the table of figures. Corresponds to the \c switch for a Table of Contents (TOC) field. The default value is "Figure."

parameters.name: IncludeLabel
parameters.description: True to include the caption label and caption number in the table of figures. The default value is True.

parameters.name: UseHeadingStyles
parameters.description: True to use built-in heading styles to create the table of figures. The default value is False.

parameters.name: UpperHeadingLevel
parameters.description: The starting heading level for the table of figures, if UseHeadingStyles is set to True. Corresponds to the starting value used with the \o switch for a Table of Contents (TOC) field. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: LowerHeadingLevel
parameters.description: The ending heading level for the table of figures, if UseHeadingStyles is set to True. Corresponds to the ending value used with the \o switch for a Table of Contents (TOC) field. The default value is 9.

parameters.name: UseFields
parameters.description: True to use Table of Contents Entry (TC) fields to create the table of figures. Use the MarkEntry method to mark entries you want to include in the table of figures. The default value is False.

parameters.name: TableID
parameters.description: A one-letter identifier that's used to build a table of figures from Table of Contents Entry (TC) fields. Corresponds to the \f switch for a Table of Contents (TOC) field. For example, "i" builds a table of figures for an illustration.

parameters.name: RightAlignPageNumbers
parameters.description: True align page numbers with the right margin in the table of figures. The default value is True.

parameters.name: IncludePageNumbers
parameters.description: True if page numbers are included in the table of figures. The default value is True.

parameters.name: AddedStyles
parameters.description: The string name for additional styles used to compile the table of figures (styles other than the Heading 1 – Heading 9 styles).

parameters.name: UseHyperlinks
parameters.description: True if entries in a table of figures should be formatted as hyperlinks when publishing to the Web. The default value is True.

parameters.name: HidePageNumbersInWeb
parameters.description: True if page numbers in a table of figures should be hidden when publishing to the Web. The default value is True.
